name: AMD Radeon RX 6800
memory_bandwidth_basis: AMD product page: GDDR6 up to 16 Gbps x 256-bit = up to 512 GB/s
notes: RDNA2, 60 CUs, 128 MB Infinity Cache, boost up to 2105 MHz, FP32 vector 16.17 TFLOPS. The non-XT card; do not conflate with amd-radeon-rx-6800-xt (300 W, same 512 GB/s bus). Used market is the affordable 16 GB tier. FLOPS basis vendor-spec-sheet. fp32 16.17 (AMD product page, peak single-precision FP32 vector); fp16 32.33 (AMD product page, peak half-precision FP16 vector). VERIFIED 2026-10-23 against https://www.amd.com/en/products/graphics/desktops/radeon/6000-series/amd-radeon-rx-6800.html: AMD RX 6800: 16 GB GDDR6, 256-bit, up to 16 Gbps => 512 GB/s.
